name: Asagiri Toyoe
source:
The home room teacher of Tomoru and Cecile. She Hates her large breasts because she was constantly sexually harassed, thus she became a nun.

Tomoru makes a bad first impression and because of that, Toyoe treats him like an irresponsible student.
